Package game.creaturestate

Interface CreatureState

All Known Implementing Classes:
BaseCreatureState, Fleeing, Foraging, Mobbing, Perching
public interface CreatureState
One state in a stateful creature's state machine.

Each implementing class owns exactly one state's three responsibilities: its ordinary per-turn behaviour, the condition(s) that decide which state comes next, and the one-off effect that fires at the moment the creature transitions into it. States are expected to be stateless/shared (the classic State pattern): any data that varies per creature belongs on the creature itself, not on the state instance. Implementations should extend BaseCreatureState, which makes two states of the same class equal.

  • Method Details

    • act

      String act(Actor creature, GameMap map)
      The creature's ordinary behaviour for a turn spent in this state. Only called when the creature is staying in this state (see nextState(edu.monash.fit2099.engine.actors.Actor, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.GameMap)); never called on the turn the creature enters it.
      Parameters:
      creature - the creature acting
      map - the map the creature is on
      Returns:
      a description of what happened, to be displayed to the player

    • nextState

      CreatureState nextState(Actor creature, GameMap map)
      Decides which state the creature should be in next, based on the creature's current situation. Returning this, or any state equal to it, means the creature stays in this state.
      Parameters:
      creature - the creature whose next state is being decided
      map - the map the creature is on
      Returns:
      the state the creature should be in next

    • onEnter

      String onEnter(Actor creature, GameMap map)
      Applies this state's one-off effect, triggered at the moment the creature transitions into it. Called instead of act(edu.monash.fit2099.engine.actors.Actor, edu.monash.fit2099.engine.positions.GameMap) on the turn the transition happens.
      Parameters:
      creature - the creature entering this state
      map - the map the creature is on
      Returns:
      a description of the transition's effect, to be displayed to the player
